items.name: Aries Cluster
items.description: A high-energy spiral galaxy said to grant bold navigation instincts to any fleet that charts through it.

items.name: Taurus Expanse
items.description: Dense with mineral-rich nebulae; prized by mining consortiums for its stable orbital belts.

items.name: Gemini Twin Arms
items.description: A binary-armed spiral galaxy known for its mirrored star formations and unstable wormhole pairs.

items.name: Cancer Shell Nebula
items.description: Encased in a protective ring of ionized gas, this galaxy shelters some of the oldest known star nurseries.

items.name: Leo Radiant
items.description: Home to a supermassive core that outputs a golden luminance visible across three sectors.

items.name: Virgo Lattice
items.description: A meticulously ordered galaxy cluster, valued for its predictable gravitational lensing patterns.

items.name: Libra Balance Field
items.description: Two counter-rotating galaxies locked in perfect gravitational equilibrium.

items.name: Scorpio Dark Reach
items.description: Shrouded in dark matter, this galaxy hides one of the densest known black hole clusters.

items.name: Sagittarius Bowshock
items.description: Named for its arrow-shaped shock front, formed by a galaxy-scale collision millions of years ago.

items.name: Capricorn Ridge
items.description: A rugged formation of ancient star clusters climbing along a long galactic filament.

items.name: Aquarius Current
items.description: Streams of ionized gas flow through this galaxy like rivers, feeding newborn star systems.

items.name: Pisces Deep Drift
items.description: Two galaxies drifting in a slow gravitational dance, destined to merge in a few billion years.
